university-of-gottingen.about:
The University of Göttingen (Georg-August-Universität) is a classic German university town institution with a long tradition in mathematics (Gauss, Hilbert) and the natural sciences, plus strong agricultural and forest sciences, law, theology and humanities, alongside several Max Planck institutes.

International applicants apply online (some via uni-assist), need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes, and pay only a semester contribution.
university-of-gottingen.aid_intl: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.
university-of-gottingen.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
university-of-gottingen.gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.
requirements: University entrance qualification recognised in Germany (or Studienkolleg)
German C1 proof (DSH-2 / TestDaF 4x4) for German-taught programmes
uni-assist or university application fee (if applicable)
Blocked account/proof of funds for the German student visa

university-of-lausanne.about:
The University of Lausanne (UNIL) shares a lakeside campus with EPFL. It is known for HEC Lausanne (business and economics), its School of Criminal Justice (forensic science), biology and medicine (with CHUV hospital), geosciences and the environment, and political and social sciences.

International applicants apply online, meet Swiss diploma-recognition rules and prove French proficiency; tuition is low by international standards.
university-of-lausanne.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught in French; non-francophone applicants must prove French proficiency or pass UNIL's French exam. Foreign diplomas must meet Swiss recognition criteria. Medicine requires the Swiss aptitude test.
university-of-lausanne.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Secondary school-leaving certificate meeting Swiss recognition criteria (some need an extra exam)
Proof of proficiency in the teaching language (German/French)
Proof of funds for the Swiss residence permit

university-of-massachusetts-amherst.about:
UMass Amherst, founded in 1863, is a large public research university in the Pioneer Valley and part of the Five College Consortium with Amherst, Smith, Mount Holyoke and Hampshire. It is known for its Manning College of Information and Computer Sciences, engineering, the Isenberg School of Management (including sport management), nursing, and polymer science.

International first-years apply via the Common App by 5 November (Early Action) or 15 January (Regular Decision), with holistic review of academics, essays and English proficiency.
university-of-massachusetts-amherst.aid_intl: Need-based federal aid is not available to international students; limited merit scholarships may be awarded.
university-of-massachusetts-amherst.tests: Holistic review; English proficiency test requirements apply to international applicants (see UMass's English Proficiency Test Requirements page). SAT/ACT policy and minimum English scores could not be verified automatically.
university-of-massachusetts-amherst.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Common App essay and any supplements
Certification of finances for the I-20/F-1 visa

university-of-minnesota-system.about:
The University of Minnesota Twin Cities is a Big Ten land-grant university with campuses straddling the Mississippi River in Minneapolis and in Saint Paul. It is known for chemical engineering, psychology, the Carlson School of Management, public health, medicine, and agricultural and environmental sciences.

Freshmen apply by one of three deadlines (1 November, 1 December, 1 January) for full scholarship and Honors consideration; tests are optional through fall 2027. Admitted freshmen who apply for housing by the deadline are guaranteed on-campus housing.
university-of-minnesota-system.aid_intl: Need-based federal aid is not available to international students; limited merit scholarships may be awarded. Applicants complete by the deadlines are considered for merit scholarships.
university-of-minnesota-system.tests: Test optional: freshman applicants through fall 2027 are not required to submit ACT or SAT scores. Non-native English speakers must provide English proficiency evidence (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo or equivalent).
university-of-minnesota-system.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Common App essay and any supplements
Certification of finances for the I-20/F-1 visa

university-of-pittsburgh.about:
Founded in 1787, the University of Pittsburgh is a state-related research university in the Oakland neighbourhood, next to Carnegie Mellon and the UPMC medical centre. It is known for medicine, nursing, pharmacy, health sciences, philosophy and history of science, and engineering.

First-year applicants are reviewed on a rolling basis, with guaranteed-admission pathways into some professional programmes. International applicants need English proficiency evidence and should apply early for merit scholarship consideration.
university-of-pittsburgh.aid_intl: Need-based federal aid is not available to international students; limited merit scholarships may be awarded.
university-of-pittsburgh.tests: Pitt is test optional for most programmes (some guaranteed-admission programmes may differ). International applicants must show English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo). Minimum scores could not be verified automatically.
university-of-pittsburgh.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Common App essay and any supplements
Certification of finances for the I-20/F-1 visa

university-of-virginia.about:
The University of Virginia is a flagship public university whose Academical Village is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is known for the McIntire School of Commerce, the Frank Batten School of Leadership and Public Policy, history, English and politics, engineering, nursing and medicine, and a strong student self-governance tradition.

International students apply through the Common App with essays, recommendations and English proficiency evidence; admission is very competitive and need-based aid is limited for non-US citizens.
university-of-virginia.aid_intl: Need-based federal aid is not available to international students; limited merit scholarships may be awarded.
university-of-virginia.tests: International applicants must demonstrate English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo or equivalent). Current SAT/ACT policy and score ranges could not be verified automatically; check admission.virginia.edu.
university-of-virginia.gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.
requirements: Common App essay and any supplements
Certification of finances for the I-20/F-1 visa
